item.title: Korea "To Closely Consult with U.S. to Ensure Agreed 15% Tariff is Upheld" (靑 “이미 합의한 15% 관세 지켜지도록 美와 긴밀히 협의”)
item.description:
Korea "To Closely Consult with U.S. to Ensure Agreed 15% Tariff is Upheld" (靑 “이미 합의한 15% 관세 지켜지도록 美와 긴밀히 협의”)

The presidential office stated on the 24th regarding the U.S. Donald Trump administration's imposition of 'forced labor tariffs' on 60 countries, including South Korea, based on Section 301 of the Trade Act, "South Korea and the U.S. share a consensus that the tariff agreement must be complied with," and added, "We will closely consult with the U.S. side to ensure that the mutually agreed 15% is ultimately upheld." (청와대는 24일 미국 도널드 트럼프 행정부가 무역법 301조를 근거로 한국을 포함한 60국에 ‘강제노동 관세’를 부과한 것과 관련해 “한미 양국은 관세 합의가 준수돼야 한다는 데 공감대가 있다”며 “최종적으로 양국 간 합의한 15%가 지켜질 수 있도록 미국 측과 긴밀히 협의해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The presidential office explained through a press notice that day, "We plan to closely consult with the U.S. side to ensure that the final agreed-upon 15% between the two countries is maintained, including matters related to the ongoing investigation into the ‘Section 301 oversupply’." Regarding South Korea being effectively subject to a forced labor tariff of 12.5%, it stated, "This forced labor tariff under Section 301 was imposed on 60 major countries based on whether they have legislated a ban on importing products made with forced labor." The tariff took effect as of 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on the 24th. (청와대는 이날 언론 공지를 통해 “아직 조사가 진행 중인 공급과잉 301조 등을 포함해 최종적으로 양국 간 합의한 15%가 지켜질 수 있도록 미국 측과 긴밀히 협의해 나갈 예정”이라며 이같이 설명했다. 한국이 사실상 12.5% 수준의 강제 노동 관세 적용 대상이 된 것과 관련해서는 “이번 강제 노동 301조 관세는 강제 노동 생산품 수입 금지 법제화 여부에 따라 주요 60국에 부과된 것”이라고 했다. 이번 관세는 미국 동부시간 기준 24일 오전 0시 1분부터 발효됐다.)

Section 301 of the Trade Act is a provision that allows the U.S. government to take retaliatory measures, such as tariffs, against unfair or discriminatory trade practices by foreign governments. South Korea is subject to investigations in both areas—forced labor and structural oversupply—and whether additional tariffs will be imposed in the structural oversupply category has not yet been decided. (무역법 301조는 외국 정부의 부당하거나 차별적인 무역 관행에 대해 미국 행정부가 관세 등 보복 조치를 할 수 있도록 한 규정이다. 한국은 강제 노동과 구조적 과잉 생산 두 분야 모두에서 조사 대상에 포함돼 있으며, 구조적 과잉 생산 분야의 추가 관세 부과 여부는 아직 결정되지 않았다.)

Earlier, the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) on the 23rd (local time) finalized the imposition of additional tariffs on products made with forced labor under Section 301 of the Trade Act. The tariffs target 60 countries, including South Korea, with a 10% tariff for countries that have implemented a ban on importing forced labor products and a 12.5% tariff for those that have not. South Korea is among the 46 countries that have not implemented such a ban, effectively facing the highest tariff rate of 12.5%. (앞서 미국 무역대표부(USTR)는 23일(현지 시간) 무역법 301조에 따라 강제 노동으로 생산된 제품에 대한 추가 관세 부과를 최종 결정했다. 부과 대상은 한국을 포함한 60국이며, 강제 노동 수입 금지 조치를 시행한 국가는 10%, 시행하지 않은 국가는 12.5%의 관세가 부과된다. 한국은 강제 노동 수입 금지 조치 미시행 국가군(46개국)에 포함돼 사실상 최고 수준인 12.5%의 관세를 적용받게 됐다.)

After the reciprocal tariffs previously imposed on various countries were ruled illegal by the U.S. Supreme Court in February, the Trump administration introduced a '10% global tariff' based on Section 122 of the Trade Act. As this measure expired on the 24th, the Section 301 tariff has replaced it. The U.S. administration stated that its investigation into oversupply capacity under Section 301 is ongoing and that further research and analysis are needed. (트럼프 행정부는 각국에 부과했던 상호 관세가 지난 2월 연방 대법원에서 위법 판단을 받자 무역법 122조에 근거한 ’10% 글로벌 관세’를 도입했고, 이 조치가 24일 만료되면서 무역법 301조 관세가 이를 대체하게 됐다. 미국 행정부는 과잉 생산 능력에 대한 무역법 301조 조사도 현재 진행 중이라며 많은 연구와 분석이 필요한 상황이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Rep. Kim Nam-hee Proposes Bill to Revive Full Case Transfer Instead of Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Rights... "Protecting Victims" (與김남희, 보완수사권 폐지 대신 전건송치 부활 법안 발의...“피해자 보호”)
item.description:
Rep. Kim Nam-hee Proposes Bill to Revive Full Case Transfer Instead of Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Rights... "Protecting Victims" (與김남희, 보완수사권 폐지 대신 전건송치 부활 법안 발의...“피해자 보호”)

Rep. Kim Nam-hee of the Democratic Party of Korea has proposed an amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that revives the full case transfer system as an alternative to abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights. Rep. Kim has been voicing concerns within the party about the potential gap in the protection of crime victims if the "complete abolition of supplementary investigation rights" were to proceed. (김남희 더불어민주당 의원이 검사의 보완수사권을 폐지에 대한 대안으로 전건송치를 부활하는 내용을 담은 형사소송법 개정안을 발의했다. 김 의원은 그간 당내에서 ‘보완수사권 전면 폐지’ 관련 범죄 피해자 보호 공백에 대해 우려의 목소리를 내왔다.)

The core of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment proposed by Rep. Kim on the 23rd is to revive the full case transfer system, which was abolished five years ago as part of the "investigation rights adjustment between prosecutors and police." This would eliminate the judicial police officer's power to close investigations, requiring all cases investigated by police officers to be transferred to prosecutors. Instead, prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights would be completely abolished, leaving only the right to request supplementary investigations for transferred cases. Rep. Kim explained, "This measure upholds the principle of separating investigation and prosecution while including ways to protect the socially vulnerable and crime victims." (김 의원이 지난 23일 발의한 형사소송법 개정안의 핵심은 5년 전 ‘검경 수사권 조정’으로 폐지됐던 전건송치를 부활시키는 것이다. 사법경찰관의 수사종결권을 삭제해, 경찰관이 수사한 사건을 모두 검사에게 송치하도록 한 것이다. 대신 검사의 보완수사권은 전면 폐지하고, 송치 사건에 대한 보완수사요구권만 남겨놨다. 김 의원은 “수사·기소 분리라는 원칙은 지키면서도 사회적 약자 및 범죄 피해자를 보호할 수 있는 방안을 담은 것”이라고 설명했다.)

The amendment also includes a provision to add "when there is concern that the defendant may harm the victim" as a ground for detention. This broadens the criteria for detention, strengthening victim protection. Additionally, a new clause requires that when the police initiate investigations into cases such as insurrection, foreign exchange offenses, anti-state activities, terrorism, major disasters, serial murders, or cases where the statute of limitations is imminent, they must promptly share key investigative details with prosecutors. Furthermore, the amendment allows complainants, accusers, and victims to present their opinions to prosecutors on case-related matters and expands the recipients of prosecutors' case processing notifications to include complainants and accusers, in addition to victims. (개정안에는 구속 사유에 ‘피고인이 피해자를 위해할 염려가 있는 때’를 추가하는 내용도 담겼다. 구속 기준을 넓혀 피해자 보호를 강화한 것이다. 또 경찰이 내란·외환·대공·테러·대형 참사, 연쇄살인, 공소시효가 임박한 사건 등에 대해 수사를 개시한 때는 지체 없이 검사와 주요 수사 내용을 공유해야 한다는 조항도 신설했다. 이 밖에 고소인·고발인·피해자 등이 검사에게 사건 관련 의견을 개진할 수 있도록 하고, 검사의 사건 처리 통지 대상에 피해자뿐 아니라 고소인·고발인도 포함하도록 했다.)

Rep. Kim stated, "No matter how right the direction of reform is, victims should not emerge as a result of shoddy investigations in the process. As the Jang Yoon-gi case showed, case outcomes should not be left to the arbitrary judgment of investigative agencies, and we must create a structure where the prosecution service and investigative agencies can check each other." (김 의원은 “개혁의 방향이 아무리 옳더라도 그 과정에서 부실한 수사로 인한 피해자가 생겨서는 안 된다”면서 “장윤기 사건에서 드러났듯 수사기관의 자의적 판단에 사건 처리가 좌우돼서는 안 되며, 공소청과 수사기관이 서로 견제할 수 있는 구조를 만들어야 한다”고 했다.)

The amendment has been co-sponsored by Reps. Seo Mi-hwa, Park Hae-cheol, Lim Mi-ae, Park Hee-seung, Hong Ki-won, Joo Cheol-hyun, Kim Dong-ah, Kim Gi-pyo, Jung Jin-wook, Kim Jun-hyuk, and Nam In-soon. (개정안에는 서미화·박해철·임미애·박희승·홍기원·주철현·김동아·김기표·정진욱·김준혁·남인순 의원이 공동 발의자로 이름을 올렸다.)

item.title: People Power Party: "We Must Compel an Investigation into the Democratic Party’s ‘Shincheonji Involvement’ Allegations" (국민의힘 “민주당 ‘신천지 개입’ 의혹, 강제 수사해야”)
item.description:
People Power Party: "We Must Compel an Investigation into the Democratic Party’s ‘Shincheonji Involvement’ Allegations" (국민의힘 “민주당 ‘신천지 개입’ 의혹, 강제 수사해야”)

The People Power Party has launched an offensive regarding the allegations of ‘Shincheonji involvement’ that have surfaced during the Democratic Party of Korea’s national convention process, urging, "President Lee Jae-myung should immediately order a strict investigation." <<> Secretary-General Chung Hee-yong stated during a floor strategy meeting that day, "President Lee emphasized at his New Year press conference in January that he would 'uproot' the allegations of political-religious collusion, calling it 'a path to national ruin.' If so, the suspicions of Shincheonji’s involvement in the Democratic Party must also be thoroughly examined under the same standards and principles." <<> Secretary-General Chung added, "The joint investigation unit of the prosecution and police conducted compulsory investigations, including a raid on the People Power Party headquarters in February and March. If they remain silent or make exceptions regarding the allegations of interference in the Democratic Party’s national convention, would the public find that acceptable?" He continued, "I urge the joint investigation unit to immediately order a strict investigation into the suspicions of Shincheonji’s involvement in the Democratic Party’s national convention, and to clearly demonstrate the principle that no one is above the law." <<> Floor Leader Chung Jeom-sik also stated at a party meeting the previous day, "We cannot take lightly the revelations of former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who recently served as prime minister and ran for the ruling party leadership with the president’s full support." Floor Leader Chung said, "If the joint investigation unit knew about the allegations of Shincheonji’s involvement in the Democratic Party but only investigated the People Power Party, that would be a clear case of targeted investigation to suppress the opposition party." He added, "They must also conduct a fair and strict investigation into the Democratic Party." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi Soo-jin also commented in a statement, "If, as claimed by the former prime minister, a specific religious group systematically interfered in the national convention to elect the ruling party leader and formed a secret alliance with political circles, infringing on party members’ sovereignty, this would be a violation of the Political Parties Act and a serious criminal act that directly contravenes the constitutional principle of separation of religion and state." (국민의힘은 더불어민주당 전당대회 과정에서 불거진 ‘신천지 개입’ 의혹과 관련해 “이재명 대통령은 즉각 엄정한 수사를 지시해달라”며 공세를 펼쳤다.)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating Drops for Third Consecutive Week to 51%... Democratic Party 44%, People Power Party 23% [Gallup Korea] (李대통령 지지율, 3주 연속 하락해 51%…민주 44%·국힘 23%[한국갤럽])
item.description:
President Lee's Approval Rating Drops for Third Consecutive Week to 51%... Democratic Party 44%, People Power Party 23% [Gallup Korea] (李대통령 지지율, 3주 연속 하락해 51%…민주 44%·국힘 23%[한국갤럽])

A poll has shown that President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for state affairs has slightly declined for the third consecutive week. (이재명 대통령의 국정 지지율이 3주 연속 소폭 하락했다는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 21st to the 23rd on 1,003 individuals aged 18 and over nationwide, the positive evaluation of President Lee's job performance stood at 51%. This marks a decrease of 1 percentage point (p) from the previous survey. President Lee's approval rating has dropped by 1%p each week for three consecutive weeks since recording 54% in the first week of July. (한국갤럽이 21~23일 전국 만 18세 이상 1003명에게 조사한 결과 이 대통령의 직무수행 긍정 평가는 51%를 기록했다. 이는 직전 조사 대비 1%포인트(p) 하락한 것이다. 이 대통령 지지도 7월 첫째 주 조사에서 54%를 기록한 이후 3주 연속 1%p씩 하락했다.)

The top reason for positive evaluations was diplomacy (17%), followed by economy and livelihoods (15%), doing well overall (9%), and communication (8%). For negative evaluations, the top reason was real estate policy (22%), followed by economy, livelihoods, and high exchange rates (10%), doing poorly overall (7%), and ethical issues and avoiding personal trials (5%). (긍정 평가 이유로는 외교(17%)가 가장 높았고, 이어 경제·민생(15%), 전반적으로 잘한다(9%), 소통(8%) 등이 꼽혔다. 부정 평가 이유는 부동산 정책(22%)이 가장 높았고 이어 경제·민생·고환율(10%), 전반적으로 잘못한다(7%), 도덕성 문제·본인 재판 회피(5%) 등이었다.)

In terms of party support, the Democratic Party of Korea recorded 44%, and the People Power Party recorded 23%. The Democratic Party rose by 4%p compared to the previous survey, while the People Power Party fell by 3%p. The gap between the two parties was 12%p immediately after the June local elections but has gradually widened to 21%p. Gallup explained, "This seems not unrelated to the imminent national convention of the Democratic Party of Korea." (정당 지지도는 더불어민주당이 44%, 국민의힘이 23%를 각각 기록했다. 민주당은 직전 조사 대비 4%p 올랐고, 국민의힘은 3%p 내렸다. 양당 간 격차는 6월 지방선거 직후 12%p였다가 점점 확대해 21%p까지 늘었다. 갤럽은 “임박한 더불어민주당 전당대회와 무관치 않아 보인다”고 설명했다.)

This survey was conducted in the format of a telephone interviewer survey (CATI) based on virtual numbers for mobile phones provided by the three mobile carriers. The margin of sampling error is ±3.1%p at a 95% confidence level, and the response rate was 10.7%. For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (이번 조사는 이동통신 3사 제공 무선전화 가상번호를 바탕으로 전화 조사원 인터뷰(CATI) 형식으로 진행됐다. 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%p, 응답률은 10.7%였다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: People Power Party Stunned as Lawmaker Grabs Floor Leader by Collar Over Committee Assignments... Leadership Vows “Strong Action Against Acts Undermining Party Dignity” (멱살잡힌 국힘 상임위 배분... 지도부 “당 품위 훼손 엄정 대응”)
item.description:
People Power Party Stunned as Lawmaker Grabs Floor Leader by Collar Over Committee Assignments... Leadership Vows “Strong Action Against Acts Undermining Party Dignity” (멱살잡힌 국힘 상임위 배분... 지도부 “당 품위 훼손 엄정 대응”)

People Power Party Secretary General Jeong Hee-yong stated on the 24th regarding the physical altercation that occurred when a party lawmaker protested committee assignments, saying, “We will respond sternly and decisively to acts that damage the party’s honor and dignity.” (국민의힘 정희용 사무총장은 자당 의원이 상임위원회 배정에 항의하는 과정에서 발생한 물리적 충돌 사태와 관련해 “당의 명예와 품위를 훼손하는 행위에 대해서는 엄정하고 단호하게 대처하겠다”고 24일 밝혔다.)

During the party’s floor leadership meeting that day, Secretary General Jeong said, “Yesterday, an incident occurred that shames the public and, as a fellow lawmaker, is deeply disheartening. In the process of protesting committee assignments, one lawmaker ultimately grabbed the floor leader by the collar, and it’s reported that even a former floor leader who tried to intervene was also grabbed by the collar.” (정 사무총장은 이날 당 원내대책회의에서 “어제 국민들께 부끄럽고 한편으로 동료 의원으로서 참담한 일이 발생했다”면서 “상임위 배정에 항의하는 과정에서 급기야 한 의원은 원내대표의 멱살을 잡았고, 이를 말리던 전임 원내대표의 멱살까지 잡는 일이 있었다고 한다”고 말했다.)

Secretary General Jeong emphasized, “Violence can never be justified. While our party members are fighting on the ground to reclaim their damaged voting rights, our party showed a shameful image of breaking decorum and order. We are sorry for causing disappointment to our party members and the public.” Secretary General Jeong also added, “At this moment, the party needs the leadership of the floor leader more than ever.” (정 사무총장은 “폭력은 결코 정당화될 수 없다”면서 “당원들께서 훼손된 참정권을 되찾기 위해 현장에서 싸우고 있는데도 우리 당은 품격과 질서를 무너뜨리는 부끄러운 모습을 보였다. 당원과 국민 여러분께 실망을 안겨드려 송구하다”고 했다. 정 사무총장은 “지금 당에는 원내대표의 리더십이 어느 때보다 절실하다”고도 했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Kwon Young-jin protested to Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik the previous afternoon regarding his committee assignment. During the exchange, voices were raised, and the situation escalated to the point where lawmaker Kwon grabbed Floor Leader Jeong by the collar. In response, the parliamentary office’s union also issued a statement that day, saying, “We deeply regret the violent act that occurred within the party, including grabbing the floor leader by the collar.” (권영진 국민의힘 의원은 전날 오후 정점식 원내대표에게 자신의 상임위 배정에 대해 항의했다. 이 과정에서 고성이 오갔고, 권 의원이 정 원내대표의 멱살을 잡는 사태까지 벌어졌다. 이와 관련해 사무처 노조도 이날 “원내대표의 멱살을 잡는 등 당내에서 발생한 폭력적 행위에 깊은 유감”이라는 입장을 냈다.)

Lawmaker Kwon told MBC, “I committed a grave discourtesy to the floor leader and apologize to fellow lawmakers as well. It was entirely my fault, with no room for excuses.” Meanwhile, Floor Leader Jeong did not attend the floor leadership meeting that day. (권 의원은 MBC에 “원내대표께 큰 결례를 범했고 동료 의원들께도 죄송하다”며 “변명의 여지가 없는 제 불찰”이라고 했다. 한편 정 원내대표는 이날 원내대책회의에 불참했다.)

item.title: People Power Party: "Real estate grand debate was a free-for-all of empty talk... Some even say 'Moon was better'" (국힘 “부동산 대토론회, 아무말 대잔치...文이 나았단 말까지 나온다”)
item.description:
People Power Party: "Real estate grand debate was a free-for-all of empty talk... Some even say 'Moon was better'" (국힘 “부동산 대토론회, 아무말 대잔치...文이 나았단 말까지 나온다”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on the 24th about the real estate grand debate presided over by President Lee Jae-myung on the 23rd, "It was a free-for-all of empty talk, surrounded by supporters cheering for the administration's real estate policies, where (the president) only said what he wanted to say." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이재명 대통령 주재로 23일 열린 부동산 대토론회에 대해 “정권의 부동산 정책을 응원하는 지지자들에게 둘러싸여 (대통령이) 하고 싶은 말만 한 아무 말 대잔치였다”고 24일 말했다.)

Representative Jang made this statement while attending the People Power Party's "Real Estate Policy Normalization Debate" held at the National Assembly on the same day, adding, "If the administration has no intention of changing its policies, then we have no choice but to change the administration." (장 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 국민의힘 ‘부동산 정책 정상화 토론회’에 참석해 “정권이 정책을 바꿀 생각이 없다면 정권을 바꿀 수밖에 없다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Representative Jang said, "Regarding the opinions carefully presented by experts, he dismissed them as 'plausible in theory but not feasible in reality.' Then, the president himself rattled off only surrealistic real estate policies." Regarding President Lee's sale of his apartment in Bundang, he added, "After watching yesterday's debate, I could clearly see why he hurriedly sold off his Bundang home. He's about to drop a property tax bomb and abolish the long-term holding special deduction, but he himself didn't want to face the tax bomb." Representative Jang also said, "There are even people saying, 'Moon Jae-in was better.'" (장 대표는 “전문가들이 고심해 내놓은 의견에 대해선 이론적으론 그럴싸하나 현실적으론 ‘안 된다’고 일축했다”며 “그래 놓고 정작 대통령 본인은 초현실적인 부동산 정책만 줄줄이 늘어놓았다”고 했다. 이 대통령의 분당 아파트 매각과 관련해서도 “어제 토론회를 보니 왜 그렇게 급하게 본인의 분당 집을 팔아치웠는지 확실히 알 수 있었다”며 “곧 보유세 폭탄을 떨어뜨리고 장기보유특별공제를 폐지할 텐데, 정작 본인은 세금 폭탄을 맞기 싫었던 것”이라고 했다. 장 대표는 “시중에선 ‘차라리 문재인이 나았다’는 말까지 나오고 있다”고 했다.)

Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong stated, "It's questionable whether a president with a mortgage setup and a prime minister who was a multi-home owner until recently can truly understand the feelings of ordinary people whose dream is to own a home. In the end, there was no presidential statement on easing loan regulations for actual homeowners or expanding housing supply—things the public and the market wanted to hear." (정희용 사무총장은 “근저당 설정 대통령과 얼마 전까지 다주택자였던 국무총리가 과연 내 집 마련이 꿈인 서민들의 심정을 제대로 헤아릴 수 있는 것인지 의문”이라며 “결국 국민과 시장이 듣고 싶어 했던 실소유자 대출 규제 완화와 주택 공급 확대에 대한 대통령의 발언은 없었다”고 했다.)

Yoo Eui-dong, chairman of the National Assembly's Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee, said, "If the president considered the buyer's circumstances, then the government's policies should also take into account the situations of young people and first-time homebuyers who desperately need a home of their own. We must revitalize the private sector's supply capacity, protect the housing ladder for actual demanders, and realign the tax system based on rationality and predictability." (국회 국토교통위원장인 유의동 의원은 “대통령이 매수인의 사정을 고려했다면 정부 정책 역시 내 집 마련이 절실한 청년과 무주택 실수요자들의 사정을 배려해야 한다”며 “민간의 공급 역량을 살리고 실수요자의 주거 사다리를 지키며 세제는 합리성과 예측 가능성을 기준으로 바로 세워야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Calls for Expanding Special Counsel Scope After Detecting Signs of NEC Statistics Manipulation (국힘, 선관위 통계조작 정황 포착에 “특검 범위 확대해야”)
item.description:
People Power Party Calls for Expanding Special Counsel Scope After Detecting Signs of NEC Statistics Manipulation (국힘, 선관위 통계조작 정황 포착에 “특검 범위 확대해야”)

The People Power Party (PPP) argued on the 24th that the scope of the 'National Election Commission (NEC) special counsel' investigation should be expanded, following the police-prosecution joint investigation headquarters' detection of signs of statistics manipulation by NEC officials and the launch of a compulsory investigation. (국민의힘은 24일 검경 합동수사본부가 선관위 실무자들의 통계 조작 정황을 포착하고 강제수사에 나서자 ‘선관위 특검’ 수사 범위를 확대해야 한다고 주장했다.)

Earlier, the ruling and opposition parties had agreed to handle the NEC special counsel bill during the July extraordinary session of the National Assembly, but they remain at odds over the scope and targets of the investigation. (앞서 여야는 7월 임시국회에서 선관위 특검법안을 처리하기로 합의했으나 수사 대상과 범위 등에서는 이견을 보이고 있다.)

Kim Seung-soo, Senior Deputy Chief of the PPP's Whip Office, said at a party strategy meeting that day, "The police-prosecution joint investigation headquarters has detected signs of voter turnout manipulation and computer system manipulation by NEC employees and has even launched a compulsory investigation," adding, "This computer manipulation incident is of a different magnitude from the ballot paper shortage incident." (김승수 원내운영수석부대표는 이날 원내대책회의에서 “검경 합동수사본부가 선관위 직원들의 투표율 조작, 전산 조작 정황을 포착하고 강제 수사까지 나섰다”며 “이번 전산 조작 사태는 투표용지 부족 사태와는 차원이 다른 사건”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "The key point is that NEC employees carried out deliberate and intentional data manipulation. This shows not only the NEC's sloppy and careless mistakes but also that malicious interference by NEC employees could affect elections," adding, "The fundamental premise of trust that data manipulation is absolutely impossible has collapsed due to this incident." (이어 “중요한 점은 선관위 직원들에 의해 고의적이고 의도적인 데이터 조작이 이루어졌다는 점이다. 허술하고 엉성한 선관위 실수뿐만 아니라 선관위 직원의 악의적 개입이 선거에 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 점을 보여준 것”이라며 “데이터 조작은 절대 불가능하다는 신뢰의 대전제가 이번 사태로 무너졌다”고 했다.)

He stated, "We must include everything related to the NEC in the investigation, including any attempt at computer manipulation," and emphasized, "In particular, a full-scale nationwide investigation of all NEC offices is unavoidable regarding this manipulation of voting statistics." He further said, "We need a 'comprehensive NEC special counsel,' not a ballot paper-limited special counsel." (그는 “일체의 전산 조작 시도를 포함한 선관위의 모든 것을 수사 대상에 포함해야 한다”며 “특히 이번 투표 통계 조작에 대해서는 전국 선관위를 대상으로 전수 조사가 불가피하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “투표용지 한정 특검이 아니라 ‘선관위 종합 특검’을 실시해야 한다”고 했다.)

Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong also said at the meeting, "What is more serious is the suspicion that the manipulation was systematic. We should not rush to end the parliamentary audit but instead extend its deadline to run parallel with the special counsel," adding, "We must launch the special counsel as soon as possible to thoroughly uncover the truth regarding not only the ballot paper shortage incident but also all suspicions, including those of statistical manipulation." (정희용 사무총장도 회의에서 “더 심각한 것은 조작이 조직적이었다는 의혹이다. 국정조사를 서둘러 끝낼 게 아니라 기한을 연장해 특검과 병행해야 한다”며 “한시라도 빨리 특검을 출범시켜 투표용지 부족 사태는 물론, 통계 조작 의혹을 포함한 모든 의혹에 대해 진실을 철저히 규명해야 한다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the Yeouido Research Institute, a PPP-affiliated think tank, held a forum that day jointly with the party's special committee on election management reform (June 3 Special Committee) to discuss plans for reforming the NEC's structure. (이런 가운데, 국민의힘 싱크탱크인 여의도연구원은 이날 당 선거관리 개혁 특별위원회(6·3 특위)와 공동으로 선관위 구조 개혁 방안을 논의하는 토론회를 개최했다.)

Professor Seung Yi-do of Konkuk University Law School, who gave a presentation at the discussion, said, "The current structure, where a sitting judge serves as the NEC chairperson and requests investigations and files complaints regarding election law violations, and then other sitting judges preside over trials on those same cases, is a classic conflict of interest—like filing a complaint with the left hand and judging it with the right hand." (이날 토론 발제를 맡은 승이도 건국대 로스쿨 교수는 “현직 법관이 선관위원장으로서 선거법 위반 행위에 대해 수사 의뢰·고발을 하는데 이를 현직 법관이 재판하는 구조는 왼손으로 고발하고 오른손으로 재판하는 전형적인 이해충돌 구조”라고 했다.)

Park Ki-joo, a research fellow at the Yeouido Research Institute, noted, "The influence and destructive power of the NEC's authority to interpret laws and file complaints against the political circle are stronger than expected," adding, "The biggest problem is the concentration of regulatory power in the NEC's secretariat. Election management duties and regulatory duties fundamentally need to be separated." (박기주 여의도연구원 연구위원은 “선관위의 유권 해석 권한과 고발이 정치권에 미치는 영향력과 파괴력이 생각보다 강하다”며 “가장 문제는 규제 권력의 사무처 집중이다. 선거 관리 업무와 규제 업무는 기본적으로 분리될 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee departs for San Francisco, USA… to meet Jensen Huang and Altman (李대통령, 美 샌프란시스코로 출국… 젠슨 황·올트먼 만나)
item.description:
President Lee departs for San Francisco, USA… to meet Jensen Huang and Altman (李대통령, 美 샌프란시스코로 출국… 젠슨 황·올트먼 만나)

President Lee Jae-myung embarked on an 11-day, 7-night overseas tour on the 24th, visiting the United States, three South American countries, and then Germany. On the first stop of the trip, in San Francisco, USA, President Lee will meet with big tech executives to discuss investment and cooperation in artificial intelligence (AI). (이재명 대통령이 24일 미국, 남미 3국에 이어 독일을 찾는 7박 11일간의 순방길에 올랐다. 이 대통령은 이날 첫 번째 목적지인 미국 샌프란시스코에서 빅테크 경영진과 만나 인공지능(AI) 투자·협력 방안을 논의한다.)

President Lee departed for San Francisco, USA, around 1:00 PM on this day from Seoul Airport in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, accompanied by First Lady Kim Hye-kyung. They were seen off by Chief Presidential Secretary Kang Hoon-sik, Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo, Acting Leader and Floor Leader of the Democratic Party Han Byung-do, and Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung. (이 대통령은 이날 오후 1시쯤 경기 성남 서울공항에서 김혜경 여사와 함께 미국 샌프란시스코로 출국했다. 강훈식 대통령 비서실장, 홍익표 청와대 정무수석, 더불어민주당 한병도 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표, 윤호중 행정안전부 장관 등이 이 대통령 내외를 환송했다.)

Upon arriving in San Francisco, President Lee will hold sequential meetings with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, and Broadcom CEO Hock Tan. (샌프란시스코에 도착한 이 대통령은 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO), 샘 올트먼 오픈AI CEO, 다리오 아모데이 앤트로픽 CEO, 혹 탄 브로드컴 CEO를 순차적으로 면담한다.)

From the 26th to the 29th, he will pay a state visit to Brazil. President Lee will meet with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for a summit and attend a Korea-Brazil Business Roundtable (BRT) in São Paulo. A meeting with Chilean President José Antonio Kast is scheduled for the 30th in Santiago, and a meeting with Argentine President Javier Milei is scheduled for the 31st in Buenos Aires. (26∼29일에는 브라질을 국빈 방문한다. 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다시우바 브라질 대통령과 조우한 이 대통령은 정상회담을 갖고, 상파울루에서는 한·브라질 비즈니스 라운드테이블(BRT)에 참석한다. 30일 칠레 산티아고에서는 호세 안토니오 카스트 대통령과의 회담이, 31일 아르헨티나 부에노스아이레스에서는 하비에르 밀레이 대통령과의 회담이 예정돼 있다.)

item.title: Government Refutes U.S. House Judiciary Committee Report Calling Coupang Subject to "Hostile Regulation" - "Measures Were Legal" (정부, ‘적대적 규제’라는 美 법사위 쿠팡 보고서 반박 “조치 적법”)
item.description:
Government Refutes U.S. House Judiciary Committee Report Calling Coupang Subject to "Hostile Regulation" - "Measures Were Legal" (정부, ‘적대적 규제’라는 美 법사위 쿠팡 보고서 반박 “조치 적법”)

The South Korean Embassy in the U.S. conveyed the Korean government's official rebuttal to the U.S. House Judiciary Committee's report on Coupang on the 23rd (local time), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 24th. Expressing regret over the U.S. House Judiciary Committee report, the government stated, "We will actively respond to Coupang's distortion of the facts." (주미 한국 대사관은 23일(현지 시각) 미국 하원 법사위가 작성한 쿠팡 관련 보고서에 대한 우리 정부의 공식 반박 입장을 미 측에 전달했다고 외교부가 24일 밝혔다. 정부는 미 하원 법사위 보고서에 대해 유감을 표명하면서 “쿠팡 측의 사실관계 왜곡에 적극 대응할 예정”이라고 했다.)

A foreign ministry official said on the same day, "Regarding the interim working-level report on Coupang released by the U.S. House Judiciary Committee on the 1st, we submitted a detailed statement to the committee to correct factual errors in the report and to explain our government's rebuttal." (외교부 당국자는 이날 “미 하원 법사위가 지난 1일 공개한 쿠팡 관련 임시 실무 보고서에 대해, 보고서상 사실관계 오류 정정 및 우리 정부 반박 입장 설명을 위한 상세 입장문을 법사위에 전달했다”고 밝혔다.)

The government's statement included the principles of Korea's regulatory legislation and enforcement, the non-discriminatory nature of Korea's digital regulations, the facts of the Coupang personal data leak incident and the validity of the Personal Information Protection Commission's actions, and the legality of measures taken by the Korean government against Coupang, including multi-agency investigations and parliamentary hearings. (정부 입장문에는 한국의 규제 입법 및 집행 원칙, 한국 디지털 규제의 비차별성, 쿠팡 개인정보 유출 사건에 대한 사실관계 및 개인정보보호위원회 처분의 타당성, 쿠팡에 대해 우리 정부가 했던 다부처 조사·국회 청문회 등 조치의 적법성 등 내용이 포함됐다.)

This rebuts the U.S. House Judiciary Committee report, which claimed that Coupang is subject to hostile regulation in South Korea. The report released on the 1st alleged that the Korean government is discriminating against Coupang, which is headquartered in the U.S., and the following day, the White House also stated, "Coupang has been targeted by the Lee Jae-myung administration." However, the Korean government has consistently maintained that its actions were a legal response to the leak of personal data of 37.56 million people from Coupang in November last year. (쿠팡이 한국에서 적대적 규제를 받고 있다는 미 하원 법사위 보고서를 반박한 것이다. 지난 1일 법사위가 공개한 보고서에는 미국에 본사를 둔 쿠팡을 한국 정부가 차별하고 있다는 내용이 포함됐고, 이튿날 백악관도 “쿠팡은 이재명 정부에 의해 표적으로 지목됐다”고 했다. 하지만 우리 정부는 작년 11월 쿠팡에서 3756만명의 개인정보가 유출된 사건에 대한 적법 대응이라는 입장을 줄곧 유지했다.)

In this statement, the foreign ministry official conveyed that the government "expresses deep regret that the U.S. House Judiciary Committee's report was based on unverified claims" and requested corrections to factual inaccuracies and the addition of omitted key facts to the report. (정부는 이번 입장문에서 “미 하원 법사위의 보고서가 확인되지 않은 주장에 기반해 작성된 데 대해 깊은 유감을 표명”하면서 보고서 상 사실과 다른 부분을 수정하고 누락된 중요 사실을 보고서에 추가해 줄 것을 요청했다고 외교부 당국자가 전했다.)

The government's policy is to manage the Coupang issue so that it does not become a burden on South Korea-U.S. relations. The foreign ministry official stated, "We plan to actively respond to Coupang's distortion of the facts by continuing to engage with the U.S. House Judiciary Committee and other American stakeholders." (정부는 쿠팡 사태가 한미 관계에 부담으로 작용하지 않도록 관리해 나간다는 방침이다. 외교부 당국자는 “법사위를 비롯한 미 조야를 지속 접촉해 쿠팡 측의 사실 관계 왜곡에 적극 대응할 예정”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-hoon of 'Ulsan Unification' Elected New Leader of Progressive Party (진보당 신임 당대표에 ‘울산 단일화’ 김종훈)
item.description:
Kim Jong-hoon, former mayor of Dong-gu, Ulsan, was elected as the new leader of the Progressive Party on the 24th. (진보당 신임 당대표로 김종훈 전 울산 동구청장이 24일 선출됐다.)

In the party leadership election held from the 20th to this day, the new leader Kim received 26,452 votes (62.51%) out of a total of 42,314 votes cast, defeating candidate Lee Seong-soo. (김 신임 대표는 지난 20일부터 이날까지 진행된 당대표 선거에서 총 투표수 4만2314표 중 2만6452표(62.51%)를 얻어 이성수 후보를 꺾고 당선됐다.)

The new leader Kim served as the mayor of Dong-gu, Ulsan Metropolitan City during his 6th and 9th terms and was elected as a member of the National Assembly for Ulsan Dong-gu in the 20th general election. In the recent June 3 local elections, he ran as a candidate for Ulsan mayor and unified with the current Ulsan mayor Kim Sang-wook, who is affiliated with the Democratic Party. (김 신임 대표는 6·9대 울산광역시 동구청장을 지냈고, 20대 총선에선 울산 동구 국회의원으로 당선됐다. 지난 6·3 지방선거에서 울산시장 후보로 출마했다가 민주당 소속 김상욱 현 울산시장과 단일화했다.)

The new leader Kim stated, "To leap forward as an alternative party chosen by the people and as a mass party preparing to take power, I will focus all our capabilities on winning the 2028 general election," adding, "In the upcoming general election, we will realize a parliamentary negotiation group and establish ourselves as the third party." (김 신임 대표는 “국민들이 선택하는 대안정당, 집권을 준비하는 대중정당으로 도약하기 위해 모든 역량을 2028년 총선 승리에 집중하겠다”며 “다가올 총선에서 원내 교섭단체를 실현하고 제3당으로 자리매김하겠다”고 했다.)

The Progressive Party had previously operated under a co-leadership system with both a standing representative and co-representatives, but it has now transitioned to a single-party leader system starting with this leadership. Accordingly, the new leader Kim will serve as the first single-party leader of the Progressive Party. (진보당은 그간 상임대표와 공동대표가 함께 운영하는 공동대표 체제였으나, 이번 지도부부터 당대표 체제로 전환했다. 이에 따라 김 신임 대표는 진보당 첫 당대표로 활동하게 됐다.)

Candidates Song Young-ju, Kim Hyun-jong, Shin Chang-hyeon, Jeong Tae-heung, and Jang Jin-sook were elected as supreme committee members. Lee Hae-ji, who ran unopposed, was elected as the leader of the Youth Progressive Party. The term of the new leadership begins on the 25th and lasts for two years. (최고위원으로는 송영주·김현종·신창현·정태흥·장진숙 후보가 선출됐다. 청년 진보당 대표로는 단독 출마한 이해지 후보가 당선됐다. 신임 지도부 임기는 25일부터 2년이다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom Says "4,700 Trillion Won Investment Is Not Exaggerated"... Hints at Mega Deals with US Big Tech (김용범 “4700조 투자 과장 아니다”... 美빅테크와 초대형 계약 예고)
item.description:
Ahead of President Lee Jae-myung's tour of three Central and South American countries and visit to San Francisco, USA, Kim Yong-beom, Chief of Staff at the Presidential Office, stated, "The government's previously announced 4,700 trillion won AI mega project is by no means an exaggeration, and it will be proven through this upcoming mega contracts with US big tech companies." He also added, "To meet the surging power demand of AI data centers (AIDCs) and climate goals, we will not view nuclear power and renewable energy as opposing forces, but rather take an integrated approach from a 'low-carbon' perspective." <<> According to Reuters, Bloomberg, and others on the 23rd, Director Kim made these remarks during a briefing for a group of major foreign correspondents, saying that this visit to San Francisco will be a historic opportunity to groundbreakingly solidify the AI and semiconductor technology and economic partnership between South Korea and the US. <<> ◇ "The 4,700 Trillion Won Blueprint Is Not an Exaggeration" <<> Director Kim expressed strong confidence in the '4,700 trillion won' investment, which had been questioned when the three mega projects were first announced. "At the time, many reacted that the number was too large, but in fact, it could be even bigger," said Director Kim. "On this occasion in San Francisco, mega long-term supply contracts and new strategic investments that have been discussed between our leading companies like Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, and Naver, and global big tech firms will be announced all at once." <<> During this trip, the 'San Francisco AI Summit' will be held in San Francisco, where CEOs of four major US global big tech companies, including Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic, along with top executives from four major Korean companies (Samsung, SK, Hyundai Motor, and Naver), will join President Lee on a semicircular stage for a discussion. At this event, President Lee is expected to deliver a 7-minute keynote, the 'San Francisco AI Declaration', and proclaim a vision to establish South Korea as the core supply chain and a stable testbed for the global AI revolution. <<> Director Kim stated, "The biggest aspect will be the signing of massive long-term supply contracts for memory chips, and concrete definitive investment agreements with global companies concerning the construction of AI data centers (AIDCs), which will expand from an initial 8.4 GW to a second phase of 18.4 GW. Looking at the numbers, people will truly realize that the AI revolution is moving at full speed." <<> ◇ "Nuclear Power and Renewable Energy Are Both 'Low-Carbon'... Break Away from Dichotomy to Fully Support Infrastructure" <<> Regarding concerns that the surging electricity demand for AIDCs conflicts with the fulfillment of national greenhouse gas reduction targets (NDCs), Director Kim outlined a plan to directly tackle the issue through 'low-carbon power innovation' encompassing both nuclear power and renewable energy. <<> "In the past, there was much controversy over small modular reactors (SMRs) or nuclear power itself, but recently its value is being reassessed from the perspective of reducing carbon emissions," explained Director Kim. "Rather than simply viewing renewable energy and nuclear power as opposing forces as before, the atmosphere is shifting towards approaching them from a 'low-carbon' perspective that reduces carbon emissions." <<> Director Kim continued, "South Korea will strictly adhere to the Framework Act on Carbon Neutrality," and added, "For technologies that can reduce carbon, such as offshore wind power, solar power, pumped storage hydropower, energy storage systems (ESS), and SMRs, the government will invest all available fiscal capacity to support their commercial realization within five years." <<> ◇ "Foreign Stock Value Rise Leads to Profit-Taking Outflows... An Unforeseen Forex Variable" <<> Director Kim explained the recent unusual phenomenon of a simultaneous surge in the domestic stock market and a rise in the exchange rate as an aftermath of foreign investors' portfolio adjustments. "As the value of domestic stocks held by foreigners has significantly increased, there has been profit-taking for asset rebalancing purposes. This is a mechanism we hadn't fully anticipated in the past," he pointed out. <<> This means that as domestic semiconductor and AI-related stock prices rose sharply, the proportion of Korean stocks within foreign funds exceeded targets, creating structural pressure leading to a weaker won as stocks were sold and proceeds converted into US dollars to rebalance portfolios. Director Kim acknowledged that the government's established foreign exchange defense mechanisms were somewhat unfamiliar with this type of shock and promised to prepare comprehensive countermeasures. <<> "In the past, our response systems were well-equipped only for crisis-type outflows, such as foreigners selling stocks and leaving or sudden withdrawals of short-term foreign debt," said Director Kim. "But this situation presents challenges from a completely different trajectory, making it difficult to cope with existing response mechanisms alone. It is now time to prepare sophisticated measures for this." <<> He added, "While massive inflows of capital and dazzling growth are good, on the flip side, entirely different dimensions of risks and challenges related to exchange rates, real estate, and prices are approaching. As the conventional mechanisms like simple buy-and-defend tactics the government has used have limitations in responding, we will establish sophisticated foreign exchange and financial stability measures suited to the changed market environment and scale." <<> ◇ "Future Response Fund Will Accumulate a Very Meaningful Amount... Must Use It Well" <<> Regarding the 'Future Response Fund' being established for the strategic use of additional semiconductor tax revenues, Director Kim stated, "A very meaningful amount of money will be accumulated," and "We must use it wisely." "The concept is to secure the tax revenue generated at this rate into the Future Response Fund and use it for four areas: youth, future, regions, and education," he said. "We need to discuss over how many years to view the long-term trend, but it will be quite substantial." <<> When asked if the scale could be predicted in the trillions of won, he responded, "It definitely exceeds that," and predicted, "Considering corporate tax and income tax on employee performance bonuses, a considerable amount can come in." However, regarding whether the use of the Future Response Fund has become more specific, he only answered, "How to set the allocation formula is crucial," adding, "We are closely monitoring long-term trends and putting effort into it." (이재명 대통령의 중남미 3국 순방 및 미국 샌프란시스코 방문을 앞두고, 김용범 청와대 정책실장은 “정부가 앞서 발표한 4700조원 규모의 AI 메가 프로젝트는 결코 과장이 아니며, 이번 미국 빅테크 기업들과의 초대형 계약을 통해 입증될 것”이라고 밝혔다. 아울러 폭증하는 AI 데이터센터(AIDC) 전력 수요와 기후 목표 달성을 위해 “원자력과 재생에너지를 대립적으로 볼 것이 아니라 ‘저탄소’ 관점에서 통합 접근하겠다”고 했다.)
